12:
Nefulah, a beast that fell, is forbidden. In what way? A beast that fell, if it was standing on its legs when it fell, if there's from its belly to the place it fell 10 Tefach we are concerned it has crushed parts. And if it was was lying and rolled down to fall, the height of the place needs to be ten Tefach. And this requirement of 10 Tefach height is specifically when it fell by itself (o.o. in B"Y), otherwise also if something else made it fall and it knew they wanted to make it fall. But if others made it fall without it being alert to it, or even if it was grazing that way except they made her fall at the same time even from less than 10 Tefach, we are concerned.

(And there's no difference her between beast or fowl, as fowl has the same rule) (Tur and B"Y and implied by the poskim)

A bird that got trampled by man's foot or he tore it on a wall, or it got dashed by a beast or it was shechted on something hard, we're concerned about it.

Rema: Also if a rock or something hard fell on its body, and same for a beast if it's something to be concerned on the beast (Kol-bo, O"W, Tur, B"Y, Ran, Rashba and R' Yerucham).

The Nefula that we said we're concerned about it if it doesn't get up, it's forbidden to shecht it till it's left for 24 hours, and if it was shechted before that time, even if they checked it and found it intact of all parts it's treif. But if it remained 24 hours and was then shechted he needs to check it against its whole entire cavity from the skull to the thigh. If there's found treifot of the treifot that the Sages designated, or if an internal part is smashed and loses its form behold it's treif even if what's smashed is one of the parts that if it's missing it's kosher such as spleen and kidneys, behold it's treif, except for the uterus, which if it's crushed behold it's permitted. But the Simanim don't need checking since Nefila doesn't disqualify them.

Rema: And if he beat it with (on?) a stone in one place it doesn't need checking except at the place it wast struck and not the rest of the parts (Kol-bo and same implied from Tur's language).
If it got up within 24 hours then Bedika suffices. (And specifically if it gets up by itself; but if they stood it up that doesn't count at all) (Ran p. E"T)
There's one who says that whatever got up and walked, even if there's found a change in its parts we don't suspect it. (Any change that wouldn't make another beast treif) (B"Y in name of Rashba).
